newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraqi Kurdish factions clash near key bridge.
newsitem.headline: Iraqi Kurdish factions clash near key bridge.

text.p: Rival Kurdish factions clashed near a strategic bridge at the village of Degala in northern Iraq as Iraqi government troops stood by, United Nations guards and foreign aid workers said on Thursday.

Their radio reports from the field, monitored in the northern Iraqi city of Arbil, said fighting was heavy between forces of the Kurdistan Workers Party (KDP) and the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan (PUK).
